plainTranslation: The classic chemistry contact. The Venus person feels wanted and pursued; the Mars person feels the pull and goes after it. Physical, immediate, hard to sit still around each other. Failure mode: mistaking heat for foundation - the attraction is real but says nothing about whether you can live together. Enjoy the spark, build the rest deliberately, and check what's under it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: Their drive and desire land right on your affection, so wanting and being wanted move fast.
summaryDeep: Their drive and desire land right on your affection, so wanting and being wanted move fast. Strong chemistry, easy to act on before you've thought it through. Enjoy the spark, and let the rest of the bond catch up to it.
tension: Failure mode: mistaking wanting someone for actually being compatible with them. Things can burn hot and fast, then you realize there may not be much holding it together once the charge settles.
advice: Let the spark introduce you. Then take a minute and see if you actually like each other.
